[quote=koranvistan;61235856][i]"Well,"[/i] she nestled further into the chair and closer to Cecilia, [i]"It's the time of year when we throw a big party to get through the winter. Back in the 1800s it spread from the Zemoyyachik' pagans to the larger kingdom when the King's Guard broke up a celebration outside of the Palace, and riots make things popular here."[/i] She chuckled and kissed the top of her head,
[i]History lesson aside, my family calls it Gyortsie Kakhou, others call it Korozovniy Yago. Local stillers, craftspeople, local kitchens; they pour out into their town centers, setting up in carts with whatever they've got to offer when the sun falls on December 15th. The next two nights are for hosting parties and then hosting the people closest to you. The more refined host balls and galas, I've always helped throw warehouse parties with Veronika. Then our extended family would get together at my Uncle's because he had the Estate. I'm not sure what my family is planning this year but I want to at least visit."[/i][/quote]
She listened attentively. [i]Id love to come with you and your family; if theyll have me, of course.[/i]

Cecilia crossed her legs and leaned her head onto Elenas shoulder, the tip of her ear softly grazing against her partners as she got into position.

[i]Or is it too early to meet the family? I mean, its been what, a year? I-[/i] her cheeks reddened slightly as she continued, [i]I [b]do[/b] love you, but I dont know how any of this is supposed to work[/i] She swirled the wine indecisively in her hand, watching it spiral within the confines of the glass.
